CHIMSOC high temperature pitched tile pipe flashings are the solution for flashing pipes through tiled roofs. Manufactured using HIGH TEMPERATURE silicone rubber, with a flexible aluminium base to allow the pipe flashing base to be adjusted to suit almost any contour.

HIGH TEMPERATURE RESISTANCE
Silicone rubber has a MUCH higher temperature resistance then EPDM rubber. Our silicone pipe flashings can be used from -50 to +225 Degrees C, and up to 260 Degrees C intermittently. It is recommended to use silicone pipe flashings for wood burning and multi fuel stove installations.

Installation
1. Pull tab design to correct size using pliers, alternatively cut.
2. Apply silicone sealant to back of flashing.
3. Remove tiles around pipe and slide flashing over pipe.
4. Fasten flashing to the roof.
5. Cut tile to fit to the top of the flashing allowing the bottom of the flashing metal base to sit on top of the tiles.

Designed to perform under pressure—literally and figuratively.

product.description:

The shower tray can be cut to size by a competent installer if necessary for fitting in non-standard spaces, but any cut edge should be sealed to prevent water ingress. Easy plumb riser kits are available separately for installation over solid floors, and the product complies with WRAS and BS EN 14527 standards for quality and safety. A 10-year warranty offers further peace of mind for long-term durability.

product.description: Fingerless compression pressure gloves are specialized garments designed to provide therapeutic benefits for the hands and wrists. They are typically made of elastic and breathable materials like spandex, nylon, or a blend of these fabrics. The gloves cover the palm and the back of the hand while leaving the fingers exposed. This design allows for greater dexterity and tactile sensitivity, making them suitable for various activities, including typing, writing, and using electronic devices. product.name: 30 Meters - Lay Flat 2in (50mm) Lined Water Discharge Aqua Hose Pipe Pump Irrigation 8-24 BAR
product.description:
A lay flat lined hose is a vital tool known for its versatility and efficiency in industrial and agricultural applications. Designed to withstand demanding conditions, these hoses typically feature a working pressure of 8 bar and a bursting pressure of 24 bar, making them robust and reliable for high-pressure tasks.

One of their primary advantages is ease of storage and transport. Unlike traditional rigid hoses, lay flat hoses are lightweight, compact, and can be quickly rolled up, making them ideal for use in confined spaces or scenarios requiring rapid deployment.

product.name: Vinyl Bath Mat Runner Non Slip UV Resistant Cut-to-Size Underfloor Heating Red 50 x 60 cm
product.description:
Vinyl Bathroom Runner - Non-slip and Hard-wearing
The attractive bath mat made of a robust vinyl-polyester mix convinces with a resistant structure and its durability. Thanks to the slip-resistant PVC backing and the high dead weight, this bathroom floor covering always stays in the desired position and does not slip. Furthermore, the insensitive bathroom carpet has an impact sound-absorbing and dirt-repellent effect and is thus optimally suited for your bathroom furnishings. Thanks to its cold-insulating properties, this bath mat also protects you from an unpleasantly cold floor after a bath or shower. Of course, the bath mat can also be used in rooms with underfloor heating.
Individual design - many designs available
Discover our large selection of different sizes, colours and designs in the bathroom rugs and thus design your bathroom individually. Whether it's just a small shower mat or a complete bath set - you'll find the right thing for your personal oasis of well-being in the bathroom at home. For a modern look, you can choose from a variety of strong and subtle colours. You can easily cut the bath mats to your own personal dimensions, or to cut out corners, for example, using a cutting tool.
Easy-care and quick to clean
The fibres of the shower mat do not absorb dirt. Contaminants remain on the surface and can thus be easily removed with a hoover or a little water. Mould stains or mould growth do not occur, as moisture does not soak into the fibres of the bathroom rugs and the bathroom floor coverings dry again quickly as a result.
Vinyl bath mat - product features:
- Material top side: 70% vinyl, 30% polyester - Material bottom side: PVC - Weight: 2.7 - 2.85 kg/m² - Thickness: 2.5 - 2.8 mm - Suitable for underfloor heating - Impact sound absorbing - Colour fastness against light (EN ISO 105-B02):

product.name: Aquarius Foundry 6 Column Horizontal Radiator in White -  600 X 1190
product.description:
The Aquarius Bathrooms Foundry 6 Column Horizontal Radiator delivers a substantial heating solution designed to establish a comforting presence at the heart of your home. With a 6 column arrangement, this horizontal radiator sits neatly beneath window frames or along principal walls to create an inviting focal point.

A white radiator is a versatile choice that sits in perfect harmony alongside the organic textures of wooden floors and soft woven fabrics. It blends seamlessly into gentle colour scheme, allowing the surrounding decorations to take centre stage. Alternatively, for homes with bold design choices, the angled aesthetics provides a striking geometric contrast against darker walls, adding a modern edge that coordinates beautifully with plush carpets and contemporary furnishings. This adaptability makes it a grounding piece that effortlessly ties an entire room together, regardless of how your personal style evolves over the years.

Why Choose a 6 Column Radiator?

A 6 column radiator is constructed with six distinct rows of vertical tubing engineered into every section. This creates an exceptionally deep, thick profile that packs a massive amount of metal surface area into a compact wall footprint.

By holding a significantly higher volume of hot water and metal mass, it offers an outstanding heat output capacity and accelerated warm up times. This makes it the premier choice for making expansive open plan family zones, grand hallways, high-ceiling conversions, or naturally drafty spaces feel genuinely cozy and snug.

Please note: This radiator operates on standard central heating networks. Radiator valves and legs are sold separately, giving you the creative freedom to select your own custom finishes to complete your space.

Aluminium Beaded Hose 45 Degree Elbow Connector for Silicone Hose Intercooler Boost Pipes (80mm OD)
product.description: 45° aluminium angle elbows provides a precision-engineered, high-performance solution for routing fluid or air hoses in tight or complex systems. Made from strong T6063 aluminium alloy, each bent tube features a smooth mirror-polished finish and consistent 1.6mm wall thickness. Standard leg length is 150mm (300mm overall), with a centreline radius matching common hose configurations. Available in a wide selection of outer diameters (from approx. 13mm up to 102mm) to suit standard hose line sizes. Ideal for coolant, intercooler, air intake, vacuum or water systems, these elbows deliver a compact, reliable 45° change of direction with minimal pressure drop. Built to withstand temperatures from −40°C to +220°C. They are lightweight for easy installation, compatible with silicone, rubber or plastic hose couplings, and engineered for corrosion resistance and optimal seal performance. These elbows are an excellent choice for professional workshops, DIY enthusiasts, and industrial applications where strength, precision and durability are required in confined spaces.

product.name: Sunhouse 200W Low Energy Tubular Heater with Thermostat - 5ft Eco-Friendly Heating Solution
product.description:
The Sunhouse SHTTH5 200W tubular heater is the perfect eco-friendly heating solution for your home or workspace. Manufactured by the renowned Dimplex Group, this 5ft heater features a built-in adjustable thermostat that allows you to easily control the heat output, ensuring a comfortable environment. Its sleek design, with light brown ends, fits seamlessly into any decor. The heater comes with brackets for easy wall or floor mounting and is equipped with a 1.5M long cable and a standard 3-pin UK plug for convenient setup. 

Designed for continuous operation, this low energy heater reaches optimal temperatures within minutes of being switched on. Its intelligent thermostat maintains a stable room temperature by automatically switching the heater on and off, providing you with consistent warmth while preventing overheating. The heater is also splash-proof to IPX4 standards, making it safe for various settings.

A Distance from internal end of cylinder (Not the thumbturn) to centre of camB Distance from external end of cylinder to centre of cam
